title: Calib M rep3: Phase7b arm M target 8 (CA2): experience store available, reuse what fits
text:

labels: /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/chembl/carbonic_anhydrase_2/ki/dataset_p7b.csv

split: pass /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/chembl/carbonic_anhydrase_2/ki/splits/frozen_carbonic_anhydrase_2.json as --split-manifest to ml.train. Do not call data.split.
store: /home/linhan_cluster/evo_vs_rsi/scientific/.artifacts/experience/experience_m_rep3.json (the `store` argument of experience.retrieve)
finish with: evaluation.locked --target CA2 --endpoint Ki --desc-set <the set you trained on> --receipt evaluation/ca2_locked.json

Report: choices and why; validation AUROC/AUPRC/EF@1%; the locked AUROC quoted from the receipt; top-100 path; wall clock and job count; experience ids reused.
